violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers -Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(5))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers -Intervene to ensure each child's safety
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found that the primary caregiver failed to intervene on several occasions causing a child to receive several less serious injuries on different occasions.

finding_variants.text: It was found that the primary caregiver failed to intervene on several occasions causing a child to receive several less serious injuries on different occasions.

During the follow up inspection a caregiver was outside with a group of school age children while an infant and a toddler were left alone inside of the childcare home. When the caregiver arrived back inside of the home the infant was walking out of the classroom and down the hallway alone.
